drivers: Houthi claims of attacks on Saudi Ras Tanura refinery
US Gulf storm shut-ins
Americas heavy-oil glut from freight squeeze; petcoke-to-coal switching risk
outlooks.summary: Supply-risk headlines (refinery attacks, storm shut-ins) are offset by a heavy-oil glut in the Americas and rising coal switching. Price is down 16% over 3 months, and the net supply-pressure score is near zero.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether the Ras Tanura attack claims are confirmed with real output loss, and how freight rates affect Americas export flows.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂遭袭和风暴停产等供应风险被美洲重油过剩及石油焦转用煤炭的趋势所抵消。价格3个月下跌16%,净供应压力得分接近零。
drivers_zh: 胡塞武装声称袭击沙特拉斯塔努拉炼厂
美国墨西哥湾风暴导致停产
运费高企造成美洲重油过剩;石油焦转用煤炭的风险
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注拉斯塔努拉袭击是否被证实并造成实际产量损失,以及运费对美洲出口流向的影响。

drivers: Sell-off driven by Fed rate-hike fears and strong dollar
ETF outflows
No supply headlines
outlooks.summary: Headlines are all about macro and demand-side selling, with no supply-shortage news. Supply is not the price driver, so there is no supply-driven upside signal.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the next US inflation data and Fed rate decision, which drive gold more than supply.
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻全部围绕宏观因素和需求端抛售,没有供应短缺方面的消息。供应不是价格驱动因素,因此没有由供应引发的上行信号。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息担忧和美元走强引发抛售
ETF资金流出
没有供应方面的新闻
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注下一份美国通胀数据和美联储利率决议,它们对金价的影响大于供应。

drivers: DRC reimposes cobalt export ban from 30 Nov (four months)
Cobalt price jumped 33% ahead of the ban
China cobalt prices at three-month high
outlooks.summary: The DRC, the dominant supplier, is halting cobalt exports for four months to lift prices. Prices have already jumped sharply, but the ban's length points to further upside as stocks tighten.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the 30 November start date for the ban and any DRC quota or early-lifting announcements.
outlooks.summary_zh: 主要供应国刚果(金)将暂停钴出口四个月,以提振价格。价格已大幅上涨,但禁令期限较长,库存收紧后仍有进一步上行空间。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)自11月30日起重新实施为期四个月的钴出口禁令
禁令前钴价上涨33%
中国钴价升至三个月高位
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注11月30日禁令生效情况,以及刚果(金)有关配额或提前解除的任何公告。

drivers: Few molybdenum-specific headlines
China extends pause on critical-mineral export curbs to US
Price already up 18% in 3 months
outlooks.summary: Headlines are mostly generic (zinc smelter halt, Indonesian sulphur shortage) and do not clearly hit molybdenum supply. The China export-curb pause is mildly bearish, and the price has already risen.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for mine or roaster disruptions and China export-licence changes before the pause ends in January 2027.
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻多为泛泛内容(锌冶炼厂停产、印尼硫磺短缺),并未明确冲击钼供应。中国暂缓出口管制略偏利空,且价格已上涨。
drivers_zh: 缺少与钼直接相关的新闻
中国延长对美关键矿产出口管制的暂缓期
价格3个月已上涨18%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注矿山或焙烧厂的中断情况,以及2027年1月暂缓期结束前中国出口许可的变化。

drivers: Zimbabwe raw lithium export ban hits processing roadblock
CATL Jianxiawo restart could ease supply
Price down 13% over 3 months
outlooks.summary: Export-ban news from Zimbabwe is supportive, but the possible CATL Jianxiawo restart points to more supply. Signals are balanced.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for confirmation of the CATL Jianxiawo restart timing and Zimbabwe's processing capacity.
outlooks.summary_zh: 津巴布韦出口禁令消息有一定支撑,但宁德时代枧下窝矿可能复产意味着供应增加。多空信号大体平衡。
drivers_zh: 津巴布韦锂原矿出口禁令遇到加工瓶颈
宁德时代枧下窝复产可能缓解供应担忧
价格3个月下跌13%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注宁德时代枧下窝复产时间的确认,以及津巴布韦的加工能力。

drivers: China expands rare earth export controls and adds 14 entities to unreliable list
Thailand bans export of chemicals used in Myanmar rare earth mining
Price +36% over 12 months
outlooks.summary: China's wider export controls and Thailand's chemical ban could cut Myanmar feedstock supply. The price is up only 4% over 3 months, so more upside is possible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for effects on Myanmar output and any new Chinese licensing rules.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国扩大出口管制,泰国禁止出口稀土开采化学品,可能减少缅甸原料供应。价格3个月仅上涨4%,仍有上行空间。
drivers_zh: 中国扩大稀土出口管制并将14家实体列入不可靠实体清单
泰国禁止出口缅甸稀土开采所用化学品
价格12个月上涨36%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注对缅甸产量的影响以及中国新的许可规定。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts squeeze supply (30 Oct)
Indonesia sulphur shortage news
Price already +56% over 12 months
outlooks.summary: Congo and Indonesia supply problems point to tightness, but the price is already up 56% in a year and recent headlines are mostly generic. Some of the risk may be priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Indonesian export volumes and any further Congo mine disruption.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果和印尼的供应问题显示市场偏紧,但价格一年已涨56%,近期新闻多为泛泛内容,部分风险可能已被定价。
drivers_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产挤压供应(10月30日)
印尼硫磺短缺的消息
价格12个月已上涨56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注印尼出口量以及刚果矿山是否出现进一步中断。

drivers: A major Chinese antimony mine halts production
China extends export-ban pause for US to 27 Jan 2027
Price down 56% over 12 months
outlooks.summary: A mine halt is supportive, but China's extended pause on export curbs and weak prices point to ample supply. The signals offset each other.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch how long the mine halt lasts and what happens when the pause ends on 27 January 2027.
outlooks.summary_zh: 矿山停产有支撑作用,但中国延长出口管制暂缓期且价格疲弱,显示供应充足。多空信号相互抵消。
drivers_zh: 中国一座大型锑矿停产
中国将对美出口禁令暂缓期延长至2027年1月27日
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注矿山停产持续时间,以及2027年1月27日暂缓期结束后的情况。

drivers: China extends gallium/germanium export-curb pause to US
Indium phosphide squeeze from AI demand
Price +67% over 3 months
outlooks.summary: The Chinese pause eases near-term fears, though licences are still required and AI demand is tight. After a 67% rise in 3 months, much of the shortage looks priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the 27 January 2027 expiry of China's pause and licence approvals.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国暂缓出口管制缓解了近期担忧,但仍需许可证,且AI需求使供应偏紧。价格3个月已上涨67%,短缺风险大部分似已被定价。
drivers_zh: 中国延长对美镓、锗出口管制的暂缓期
AI需求导致磷化铟供应紧张
价格3个月上涨67%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注2027年1月27日中国暂缓期到期及许可证审批情况。

drivers: Houthi claims of attacks on Saudi Ras Tanura refinery
US Gulf storm shut-ins
Heavy-oil glut in Americas and coal switching risk
outlooks.summary: Refinery and storm disruptions are offset by an Americas heavy-oil glut and coal switching. The price is up 15%, and the net supply-pressure score is near zero.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch confirmation of refinery output losses and green coke feedstock availability.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂和风暴干扰被美洲重油过剩及转用煤炭所抵消。价格上涨15%,净供应压力得分接近零。
drivers_zh: 胡塞武装声称袭击沙特拉斯塔努拉炼厂
美国墨西哥湾风暴导致停产
美洲重油过剩及转用煤炭的风险
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注炼厂产量损失的确认情况以及生焦原料的供应。

drivers: Refinery attack claims and storm shut-ins
Heavy-oil glut in Americas
Petcoke rally narrowing discount to coal
outlooks.summary: Supply-risk news is balanced by glut and switching headlines. Prices are up 46% over 12 months but down 5% over 3 months, so there is no clear shortage signal.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the petcoke-to-coal discount and any confirmed refinery outages.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应风险消息被过剩和燃料转换的消息所平衡。价格12个月上涨46%,但3个月下跌5%,没有明确的短缺信号。
drivers_zh: 炼厂遭袭传闻和风暴停产
美洲重油过剩
石油焦价格上涨使其相对煤炭的折价收窄
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注石油焦相对煤炭的折价以及已确认的炼厂停产情况。
